newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan steel stocks rebound in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan steel stocks rebound in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Taiwan's steel sector rose in early Thursday trade after falling during a recent consolidation and brokers said they expected further gains in the sector.
After one hour, the steel sector advanced 1.01 percent whilr the overall market had edged 0.43 percent higher.
Tung Ho Steel gained 60 cents or 2.23 percent to T$27.50 and China Steel rose 20 cents or 0.8 percent to T$24.50, both in active trade.
"As the steel industry is fundamentally good, low-priced steel stocks are good targets for investors when the market is slow," said Clint Cheng of China Securities.
